label: NIH Stroke Scale: original clinical examination scale
reviewScope: Primary bibliographic identity located; no newly claimed clinical scoring review. Complete item entry is separate from a partial numeric sum.
population: Stroke severity examination; use the scale's complete standardized item instructions.
limits: A partial total is not a completed examination or an individualized prognosis.

label: Cockcroft–Gault creatinine clearance
sourceIdentity: Cockcroft and Gault, Prediction of creatinine clearance from serum creatinine, Nephron 1976;16:31-41
reviewScope: Existing formula provenance retained. No clinical review date was recorded for this calculation; adding a source link is not a new clinical review.
limits: Confirm stable creatinine, appropriate weight convention, and the specific drug label; this estimate does not determine a dialysis indication.

label: ICH Score original report
reviewScope: Existing PubMed identity/title/year/DOI metadata verification retained; no full-text clinical-claim review was recorded in the citation.
limits: A severity score is not an individual prognosis or a sole basis for limiting life-sustaining treatment; retained AHA/ASA 2022 ICH source qualifiers apply.

label: ABC/2 hemorrhage volume
sourceIdentity: Kothari et al., The ABCs of measuring intracerebral hemorrhage volumes, Stroke 1996;27:1304-1305
reviewScope: Existing Kothari formula provenance retained and primary identity/abstract located. No newly claimed full-text clinical review.
limits: Confirm all three dimensions are in centimeters. Volume arithmetic does not establish treatment selection.

label: Glasgow Coma Scale original report
sourceIdentity: Teasdale and Jennett, Assessment of coma and impaired consciousness. A practical scale, Lancet 1974
reviewScope: Primary source identity located; no newly claimed item-scoring or current worksheet review.
limits: All three components must be entered. A total does not replace component assessment or establish an individual prognosis.

label: DAWN historical partial screen
reviewScope: Existing late-window evidence-claim review date retained; original citation verification limits remain applicable.
population: Original DAWN age/severity/core-volume strata, 6-24 hours from last known well.
limits: Partial historical trial screen; confirm ICA/proximal MCA occlusion, baseline function and all original exclusions. Failure does not exclude EVT under newer evidence.

label: DEFUSE-3 historical partial screen
reviewScope: Existing late-window evidence-claim review date retained; original citation verification limits remain applicable.
population: Original DEFUSE-3 age/severity/perfusion screen, 6-16 hours from last known well.
limits: Partial historical trial screen; confirm ICA/proximal MCA occlusion, baseline function and all exclusions. Hypoperfused volume includes the core; it is not salvageable-only volume. Failure does not exclude current EVT.

label: Retained large-core EVT source context
reviewScope: Existing evidence-claim date retained. AIS source has separate 2026-09-30 review scope and partially applied correction warnings.
limits: Preserve each recommendation's time window, age, prestroke function, mass-effect and imaging bounds. Historical screens are not universal EVT gates.

label: Acute DAPT source context
reviewScope: Existing DAPT evidence-claim date retained; AIS recommendation transcription retains its own review/correction limitations.
population: Source-specific noncardioembolic minor stroke or high-risk TIA populations.
limits: Retain trial-specific time, severity, mechanism, hemorrhage, reperfusion and contraindication review. Treatment selection is not arithmetic.
